name: Caipirasuchus
sum: Caipirasuchus is a sphagesaurid notosuchian from the Late Cretaceous of São Paulo and Minas Gerais, Brazil, with six named species.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: Not stated in the sources consulted for this draft; C. paulistanus was named by Iori and Carvalho in 2011.
material: Remains of six species from the Adamantina and Santo Anastácio formations.
biology: C. catanduvensis has a distinct chamber associated with the airways, possibly used in vocalisation.
author: Iori and Carvalho 2011
